Record Class TerrariumCell

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.swarmforge.core.domain.TerrariumCell
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record TerrariumCell(int x, int y, int z, TerrariumCell.Material material, float[] pheromones, float temperature, float humidity, float co2, float o2, float n2o, float light, float windX, float windY, float pressure) extends Record implements Serializable
Represents a single cell (voxel) in the terrarium. Each cell has a material type, pheromone levels, and environmental properties.

Environmental properties (SI Units):

  • Cell Size: ≤ 1.0 mm³ (SI base unit resolution)
  • Temperature (°C / K) - affects metabolism and movement speed
  • Humidity (%) - affects water needs and comfort
  • CO2 level (ppm) - indicator of colony activity
  • O2 level (%) - indicator of ventilation
  • N2O level (ppm) - Nitrous oxide concentration from soil microbial activity
  • Light level (lux / 0-1) - affects circadian behavior
  • Wind (m/s x,y components) - affects pheromone diffusion
  • Pressure (hPa / Pa) - for altitude simulation
